theater: 伯羅奔尼撒東北部弗利俄斯

battle.name: 推翻狄奧多特二世的行動
battle.theater: 伯羅奔尼撒東北部弗利俄斯
battle.brief: 西元前230年，亞該亞聯盟在馬其頓王安提柯三世率領下進攻拒絕入盟的弗利俄斯，企圖廢黜僭主狄奧多特二世。該城立於岩台高處，進攻方以龜甲陣逼近城牆，屢遭守軍反衝。卡面科林斯青銅盔就是盟軍頭盔：眼縫狹窄，戴者只能靠方陣與龜甲的紀律保命。圍城終因營中疫病與議會決議解散而告吹。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場圍城的交戰雙方，是伯羅奔尼撒東北部的小城邦弗利俄斯，以及以亞該亞聯盟為骨架組成的希臘聯軍。弗利俄斯立於科林斯灣以北數十里的內陸高地上，三面是陡峭岩坡，只有南面一條狹窄山道可以通向城下；城內由寡頭家族與僭主狄奧多特二世把持，守軍以城民兵與久經戰陣的輕裝步兵為主，靠城牆與高度守城，人數有限但地勢極利。聯軍的名義是亞該亞聯盟各邦的聯合軍，實際指揮權握在馬其頓王安提柯三世·多松手裏，他以聯盟將軍的名義調集亞該亞、科林斯、墨加拉等邦的步兵方陣，輔以馬其頓重騎兵、帖薩利輕騎與少量外邦傭兵弓箭手。聯盟的戰時體制是雙層的：安提柯掌軍政，重大決策須由各邦代表在議會投票表決，議會通常在亞該亞的埃吉翁召開。順境時這套體制能把各邦捏成一支軍隊，逆境時卻足以讓一場圍城被一紙決議連根拔起，弗利俄斯之役正是這條弱點最清楚的一次顯形。糧餉由各邦按比例攤派，攻城器械與兵員則由聯盟中央分批配置，圍城一久，運輸與徵收的負擔便全部壓在安提柯一人身上。
countriesEn: The two sides in this siege were the small Peloponnesian polis of Phlius, in the north-east of the peninsula, and a Greek coalition built around the Achaean League. Phlius sat on high ground some tens of miles north of the Gulf of Corinth, hemmed in by steep rock slopes, with a single narrow track climbing to the walls from the south; inside, power belonged to the leading families and to the tyrant Diotimus II, and the garrison was made up of the city's militia and of light infantry with long experience, few in number but fighting from a commanding position behind good walls. The coalition was formally a levy of the Achaean League's member states, but real command rested with the Macedonian king Antigonus III Doson, who as league general drew in hoplite phalanxes from Achaea, Corinth and Megara, backed by Macedonian heavy cavalry, Thessalian light horse and a small number of foreign mercenary archers. The league's wartime structure had two layers: Antigonus controlled the army, but major decisions required a vote among the delegates of the member states, and the assembly normally met at Aegium in Achaea. In good weather that structure could weld the cities into one army; in bad weather it was enough for a single resolution to pull the whole siege down, and the campaign against Phlius showed that weakness more plainly than any other. Grain and pay were apportioned among the member states, while the siege engines and the troops were allotted in batches by the league's central command, so that as the siege dragged on the burden of transport and collection fell entirely on Antigonus.
people: 安提柯三世·多松是這場行動的總指揮。這位馬其頓王早年以攝政身分穩住北境，登上王位後隨即以亞該亞聯盟將軍的身分介入希臘事務，他把弗利俄斯圍城視為聯盟整頓內部、加強科林斯灣東岸控制的一環，而不是一次單純的城邦報復；圍城期間他不斷要求聯盟議會延續軍令，議會最終決議解散軍隊時，他是全軍唯一公開表示不滿的人。僭主狄奧多特二世是弗利俄斯的實際統治者，這位同名的第二任僭主接管城邦後把持行政與稅收，倚靠城牆與支持者維持城市的獨立，正是聯盟要拔除的對象。真正打出名聲的是斐洛波門：這位當時年輕的亞該亞軍人隨軍擔任騎兵，在強攻弗利俄斯城牆的一役中隨騎兵隊殺入敵陣，座騎被殺之後仍步戰突圍而負重傷，其表現讓安提柯記住了這個名字，日後他成為聯盟最能打的將軍之一。史家波利比烏斯是這段記載的主要來源，他出身亞該亞貴族之家、父親曾任聯盟將軍，他本人雖然不在營中，卻以聯盟同情者的身分留下了這場圍城最完整的記述。城內方面則是弗利俄斯的守城將領與執事議員，組織反衝、修補城牆、供給守軍食物與飲水，僭主本人則留在城中主持大局，幕僚與稅吏照常運作，直到聯軍撤圍才敢相信圍城已經解除。
peopleEn: Antigonus III Doson was the overall commander of the operation. Having stabilised the northern frontier as regent and then taken the Macedonian throne, he intervened in Greek affairs as general of the Achaean League; he treated the siege of Phlius as a step towards disciplining the League and tightening its grip on the eastern shore of the Gulf of Corinth rather than as a private vendetta against a polis, and while the siege lasted he pressed the assembly to keep the army in the field, so that when the assembly finally voted to disband he was the only man in camp to protest openly. Diotimus II was the effective ruler of Phlius: the second of that name to hold the tyranny, he controlled administration and taxation and relied on the walls and on his supporters to maintain the city's independence, and he was precisely the man the League meant to remove. The name made at Phlius was Philopoemen's. Then a young Achaean soldier serving with the cavalry, he rode into the enemy during an assault on the walls, lost his horse, fought on on foot and was carried off wounded; Antigonus remembered him, and he later became one of the most formidable generals the League ever had. The principal source for the episode is the historian Polybius, born into an Achaean aristocratic house whose father had served as league general; Polybius was not in the camp himself, but he left the fullest surviving account of the siege as a sympathiser of the League. On the other side, Phlius's garrison commanders and its council of elders organised counter-charges, repaired the walls and provisioned the defenders, while the tyrant stayed inside the city directing the defence, his secretaries and tax-collectors keeping the administration running, and none of them dared believe the siege was over until the coalition withdrew.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔，約從西元前650年前後開始使用，是希臘重裝步兵最標準的頭部防具：整張青銅面甲開成一條窄眼縫，兩側有護頰，額前加冠飾，盔頂有脊。戴上它的人看得見的只有正前方一小條光，轉頭要靠整個身體，因此它從來不是個人裝備，而是隊形裝備，在弗利俄斯城下這點被推到極致。聯軍的步兵進攻弗利俄斯時把方陣收成龜甲陣：前排的盾牌舉在頭頂，後排把盾搭在前排的盾背與盔頂上，形成一條可以整體移動的龜殼，人躲在下面緩步逼近城牆。卡面的青銅盔正是這道龜殼的最外層，眼縫狹窄的戴者在逼近城牆的一刻只能靠前排替自己擋住來自高處的投槍與石頭，一旦隊形被側翼輕兵打亂，這種頭盔立刻從護具變成累贅。除了頭盔，聯軍步兵配備的是重標槍與方盾的標準組合，短劍只作最後的近身手段；攻城側則有隨軍工程兵操作的有頂棚撞槌，這件器械在希臘戰爭中屢試不爽，也是波利比烏斯記載本役時特別提到的東西。輕裝步兵使用擲槍、投石索與小型盾牌，馬其頓重騎兵用長槍，帖薩利輕騎用投槍；攻城軍隊的柱木、柴薪與糧秣靠牛車輸送，營地以皮帳與壕溝圍出，井與汲水點的設立也關係到後來的疫病情形。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card, in use from about 650 BC, was the standard piece of head protection for the Greek heavy infantry: a single bronze face-piece pierced by a narrow eye-slit, with cheek-pieces at the sides, a crest holder at the brow and a ridge along the top. The man inside it could see only a thin strip straight ahead and had to turn his whole body to look aside, so the helmet was never an individual piece of equipment but a formation piece, and at Phlius that logic was pushed to its limit. When the coalition infantry advanced on the city they folded the phalanx into a testudo: the shields of the front rank were held overhead, those of the ranks behind laid on the backs of the shields and helmets in front, forming a shell that moved as one body, and the bronze helmet on the card is the outermost layer of that shell. A man with a narrow eye-slit, creeping up to the wall, could only survive because the men in front of him absorbed the javelins and stones thrown down from above; the moment the formation was shaken by light troops on the flank, the same helmet became a handicap. Apart from the helmet, the coalition infantry carried the standard pairing of heavy pike and large shield, with the short sword reserved for the last moments at close quarters. On the siege side the engineers worked a covered battering ram, a device that had served Greek armies repeatedly and that Polybius singles out in his narrative of this campaign. Light infantry used javelins, slings and small shields; Macedonian heavy cavalry carried long spears and the Thessalian light horse javelins. The timber, fuel and grain for the siege works were moved on ox-carts, the camp was pitched in leather tents ringed by a ditch, and the siting of wells and water-drawing points had a bearing on the sickness that came later.
tactics: 弗利俄斯的城池建在一片被溪流切開的高原上，唯一的進城道路是南面的緩坡，攻方幾乎沒有展開寬正面兵力的地方。安提柯的做法是先封路再攻城：以騎兵巡邏切斷城周通向科林斯、克萊奧奈與西基昂的各條道路，控制平原上的農地與水源，讓城內無法靠外運糧草、也無法等來援軍；再把步兵方陣集中在南面唯一可行的方向上，用龜甲陣一寸一寸向前推，把覆著皮頂的撞槌送到城牆下。守方的應對是標準的希臘守城法：城頭以擲槍手與投石手覆蓋接近路線，滾木與石頭砸向密集的盾陣，遇到危險就開城門出城反衝，直接撞散龜甲陣的前排，順手燒掉攻城器械。弗利俄斯的輕裝步兵尤其難纏，他們不留在城牆上，而是分散到城周坡地與樹石之間，專打落單的傳令兵、運糧隊與工程兵，拖住進攻節奏。聯軍這邊最要命的不是敵手，而是自己的營務：盛夏的營地擠在谷底與溪流旁，取水要走遠路，糞便與廢棄物堆積在營地低處，飲水一開始就不乾淨，接著營中出現大批非戰鬥減員。等消息傳回各邦代表耳中，議會以季節與疫病為由決定解散軍隊，圍城就此崩掉。
tacticsEn: Phlius stood on a plateau carved by streams, reachable by a single gentle slope from the south, so the besiegers had almost nowhere to deploy a wide front. Antigonus's method was to close the roads before he stormed the city: cavalry patrols cut the routes that ran from the city towards Corinth, Cleonae and Sicyon and took control of the fields and the water sources on the plain, so that the city could neither import grain nor expect allies; then he concentrated the hoplite phalanx on the only practicable axis of approach and pushed it forward in testudo, one slow step at a time, until the covered ram could be brought up to the wall. The defenders answered with the standard Greek conduct of a siege: javelinmen and slingers on the ramparts swept the approach, logs and stones came down on the packed shields, and when the danger was worst the gates opened and the garrison charged out, smashing the front rank of the turtle and setting fire to the engines. Phliusian light infantry were the most awkward of all: rather than staying on the wall they spread through the scrub and broken ground around the city, picking off stragglers, supply parties and engineers and slowing the rhythm of the assault. What finally undid the besiegers was not the enemy but their own camp routine. The army was penned in the valley bottom beside the stream through the height of summer; water had to be carried a long way; refuse and dung accumulated in the low ground; the drinking supply was dirty from the first day; and then mass non-battle casualties appeared among the troops. When the news reached the delegates of the member states, the assembly dissolved the army on the grounds of the season and the plague, and the siege collapsed with it.
data: 可核對的數字不多，年代本身就有分歧：本卡把這場行動定在西元前230年，而主要史料波利比烏斯把它放在前229至前228年那一段聯盟戰役序列中，因此不同年表會略有出入。地理是可核的：弗利俄斯在伯羅奔尼撒東北部，離科林斯灣北岸約五十公里，聯盟議會所在的埃吉翁到城下按直線算約九十公里，聯軍自灣岸沿公路東行再折入阿索波斯河谷才能抵達；城址在海拔數百公尺的高台上，四周是陡坡與沖溝，攻城方無處展開大盾縱陣。軍力方面，聯盟步兵由各邦按比例抽調，量級在以萬計，但聯盟文獻與波利比烏斯都沒有留下確數；騎兵以馬其頓與帖薩利兩部為主，數量遠少於步兵，這在攻城戰裡意味著對平原的正面封鎖壓力有限。攻城器械至少有一座有頂棚的撞槌。圍城延續了數月，時間不算短；強攻每次都被打退，進攻方留下可觀傷亡，確切人數無從考證；營中疫病造成的非戰鬥減員，史料只說眾多，同樣沒有數字可引。
dataEn: Few figures survive, and even the date is disputed: this card places the action in 230 BC, while the principal source, Polybius, sets it within the run of league campaigns of 229 to 228 BC, so chronologies differ slightly. The geography can be checked. Phlius lay in the north-east of the Peloponnese, some fifty kilometres from the north shore of the Gulf of Corinth, and the league assembly city of Aegium lay about ninety kilometres away in a straight line; the coalition marched east along the bay road before turning inland into the valley of the Asopos. The site itself stood on a plateau several hundred metres above the plain, ringed by steep slopes and gullies, leaving the attackers no room to deploy a deep shield wall. On strength, the league infantry was levied from the member states in quotas and numbered in the order of the tens of thousands, but neither league records nor Polybius preserve an exact figure; the cavalry, drawn mainly from Macedonia and Thessaly, was far smaller, which in a siege meant limited pressure on the open country. At least one covered battering ram was in use. The siege ran for a number of months, which is not a short time; each assault was thrown back and left the attackers with heavy casualties, of which no tally survives; and the plague in the camp produced a large non-battle loss, of which the sources say only that it was great.
cause: 打起來的直接理由，是亞該亞聯盟要把弗利俄斯拉回聯盟體制，並順手拔掉城中的僭主狄奧多特二世。聯盟自克萊奧梅內斯戰爭之後就以解放為名推動希臘統一，把各城邦的城防、人口與外交收進共同框架；弗利俄斯卻是這套框架最不合作的成員之一。這座城有自己歷史悠久的寡頭傳統，靠閉塞的地形與豐饒的高地農地維持獨立，對外來干涉向來敏感；僭主狄奧多特二世上臺後，把持行政與稅收，壓制了原有的公民議事傳統，城內對聯盟的敵意因此有了具體的人與利益載體。外部因素是埃托利亞聯盟的煽動與聯盟內部的派系角力：安提柯需要的不只是打下一座城，而是要讓所有看到弗利俄斯背叛聯盟的城邦明白，退出是要付代價的。聯盟的決策過程本身也推了一把：議會以多數決議開戰，聯軍統帥安提柯則把圍城視為聯盟整頓與海上通道控制的一步，於是出兵成了黨派與路線之爭的延伸。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the war was that the Achaean League wanted Phlius back inside its arrangements, and the tyrant Diotimus II out of the city. Since the war against Cleomenes the league had advanced Greek unity under the banner of liberation, pulling the defence, population and diplomacy of the cities into a common framework; Phlius was among the least cooperative members of that framework. The city had its own old oligarchic tradition, kept itself independent thanks to closed terrain and rich upland farmland, and was historically sensitive to outside intervention. Once Diotimus II took the tyranny, administration and taxation passed into his hands and the city's older council customs were suppressed, so that hostility to the League acquired a person and an interest to attach itself to. Outside factors were the encouragement of the Aetolian League and the factional struggle inside the coalition: what Antigonus needed was not merely one captured city but a demonstration to every other polis that seceding from the League carried a price. The decision-making machinery of the League itself contributed: the assembly voted the war, while Antigonus as commander treated the siege as part of the League's reorganisation and of the control of the sea lanes, so that the expedition became an extension of factional and strategic rivalry.
impact: 這一役的影響，主要落在兩個方向。第一個是聯盟制度：安提柯在議會上把話說得很明白，聯盟的軍隊不該由各邦代表憑一季天氣或一場疫病就解散，議會最終仍然解散了軍隊，這個裂痕在後來亞該亞與馬其頓的關係裡一直發酵，也讓聯盟此後在兵員與指揮上更依賴安提柯個人。第二個是戰術與技術：弗利俄斯的高地城防證明，對付居高臨下的岩台城市，希臘式的重裝步兵方陣幾乎沒有正面突破的機會，攻城方只能靠龜甲陣、撞槌與騎兵封鎖這樣的組合去換取時間，而每一次換取都要用人命和疫病去付帳。斐洛波門在這一役嶄露頭角，這個名字日後會出現在聯盟對斯巴達的戰爭裡，成為聯盟最能打的將軍。安提柯本人則在圍城解除後轉向基克拉澤斯群島與歐玻亞島上的城市，把希臘中部與海峽的航路握在聯盟手上；可以說，弗利俄斯沒有被拿下，但聯盟從此對科林斯灣東岸的注意力再也沒有放鬆過。
impactEn: The consequences ran in two directions. The first concerned the institutions of the League. Antigonus said openly that an army levied from the member states should not be dissolved by its own delegates on the strength of a season's weather or an outbreak of disease, and the assembly nevertheless dissolved the army; that fissure never stopped troubling the later relations between Achaea and Macedon, and from that point the League leaned harder on Antigonus's personal command for troops and control. The second concerned tactics and technique. The high defences of Phlius demonstrated that against a city perched on a rocky plateau the Greek heavy phalanx had almost no chance of a frontal breakthrough: the besiegers could only buy time with the testudo, the ram and a cavalry blockade, and every hour of that purchase was paid for in lives and in sickness. Philopoemen made his name in the fighting here, and the name would later appear in the League's wars against Sparta as that of its hardest general. Antigonus himself, freed from the siege, turned to the Cyclades and to the cities of Euboea, and put the sea lanes of central Greece and the straits into League hands; Phlius was not taken, but the League never again relaxed its attention to the eastern Gulf.
result: 圍城最終沒有以攻破城牆收場。聯盟議會在疫病蔓延的形勢下決議解散軍隊，聯軍各部帶著病患與傷員撤回亞該亞，弗利俄斯的城牆一磚未損，狄奧多特二世這個名號也在城內失去大半支持。從戰役層面看，這是一場典型的攻方失敗：野戰主力無法在狹窄地形裡展開，龜甲陣的推進速度低到每次只送出數十步，撞槌還沒送到牆下就被反衝與側翼擾亂拖垮，而疫病把最後一點時間也吃掉了。從政治層面看，聯盟的目的並沒有全部落空：狄奧多特二世被推翻，弗利俄斯最終回到聯盟框架之內，聯盟對科林斯灣東岸的秩序也從此固定下來。圍城的失敗反而逼出兩個長遠結論：聯盟必須有能承受議會干預的常備指揮機制，而希臘重裝步兵在攻城戰裡的天花板，是由城牆高度與青銅盔的視野共同決定的——戴著卡面那樣頭盔的人，只有靠隊形才能活。
resultEn: The siege did not end with the walls breached. With the plague spreading, the league assembly voted to disband the army, the coalition pulled back towards Achaea with its sick and its wounded, and not a single stone of the walls of Phlius was carried off; the name of Diotimus II also lost most of its support inside the city. In military terms this was a textbook failure of the attacker: a field army could not deploy in narrow ground, the testudo advanced so slowly that each push covered only a few tens of paces, the ram never reached the wall before counter-charges and flank harassment dragged the whole business to a halt, and disease then consumed the time that was left. In political terms the League's aims were not wholly defeated: Diotimus II was overthrown, Phlius eventually returned inside the League's framework, and the League's order on the eastern Gulf was fixed from then on. The failure of the siege produced two long-term conclusions instead: the League needed a permanent command mechanism able to withstand interference from its own assembly, and the ceiling of Greek heavy infantry in siege warfare was set jointly by the height of the walls and by the field of vision of the bronze helmet — a man wearing the helmet on the card could only stay alive inside his formation.
